title: Brandon "Scoop B" Robinson‏ Interviews NBA Great Julius Erving
htmlContent: Sports and Entertainment Journalist Brandon ‘Scoop B’ Robinson had the opportunity to speak with NBA legend Julius " Dr. J" Erving about making the comparison to other NBA greats like Michael Jordan and Lebron James.  In addition, Scoop B asked Erving did he live through a time where he was compared to other players. Erving goes on to say that he was compared to Elgin Baylor and Connie Hawkins and gives his all time starting five. The full interview can be view above and make sure check out more episodes from Scoop B at ScoopBRadio.com
